capstone_projects.title: Compliance-Ready Pipeline Audit
capstone_projects.expected_result: A structured audit report mapping each identified issue to its failure zone (upstream / pipeline / downstream), with proposed remediation steps and compliance status for each finding.
capstone_projects.problem_statement: A pharma company's clinical trial data pipeline has failed a compliance review. You have been handed the pipeline documentation, schema history, and audit logs. Diagnose the root causes, apply AI-assisted analysis, and produce a regulatory-ready audit findings document.

capstone_projects.title: AI-Assisted Pharmacovigilance Data Triage
capstone_projects.expected_result: A triage summary classifying anomalies by type and severity, with remediation recommendations and a compliance risk rating for each issue, documented for regulatory review.
capstone_projects.problem_statement: A batch of pharmacovigilance data has arrived with anomalies. Use GenAI tools to synthesize the error patterns, classify them by severity, and recommend which issues require immediate human expert review versus automated remediation — with full auditability.

capstone_projects.title: Life Sciences Data Source Map and Governance Proposal
capstone_projects.expected_result: A data source classification matrix and a governance framework outline covering access controls, audit trail requirements, and data quality checks for each source type.
capstone_projects.problem_statement: A new clinical trial has kicked off. Map all incoming data sources (EDC, LIMS, CTMS, EHR, claims) to their domains, classify them by data type and regulatory constraints, and propose a governance framework for the pipeline.

capstone_projects.title: Regulatory Data Quality Assessment with AI
capstone_projects.expected_result: A compliance-annotated data quality report flagging issues against 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, with a prioritised remediation plan and documentation trail ready for regulatory submission.
capstone_projects.problem_statement: You have received a batch of clinical trial data ahead of a regulatory submission. Use AI tools to assess data quality against FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, flag non-compliant records, and draft a prioritised remediation plan with a documented audit trail.

capstone_projects.title: Schema Drift Incident Response Plan
capstone_projects.expected_result: A documented incident response plan covering diagnosis steps, schema drift findings, AI-assisted analysis outputs, remediation timeline, and a post-incident review summary.
capstone_projects.problem_statement: You are on-call when a production clinical data pipeline begins failing. Error logs show schema drift across three source systems simultaneously. Design a structured response — from initial diagnosis through remediation — using both RCA frameworks and AI-assisted log analysis.
